# BugsFixer Pakistan – IT Services & Max Sale ERP Solutions

> BugsFixer is Pakistan's leading IT service center based in Peshawar. We engineer turn-key CCTV video surveillance, chip-level laptop repairs, biometric access control, Cat6 networking, and custom Max Sale ERP software.

## Core Technical Services
- CCTV Installation & Video Surveillance (Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview 4K IP & HD Analog)
- Workstation & Laptop Chip-Level Repair (Dell Latitude, HP EliteBook, ThinkPad, MacBook)
- Biometric Attendance & Smart Locks (ZKTeco, Hikvision Face AI, Electromagnetic Locks)
- Networking & PABX Telephony (Cisco Switches, MikroTik Routers, Ubiquiti Mesh Wi-Fi, Grandstream IP-PBX)
- Max Sale ERP Software (POS Billing, Python LAN Master-Terminal Server, Multi-Branch Web Analytics)
